title: 第23章 大师兄长空灵儿名静姝第24章 云海四霸
lines: 能叫玉龙上人六师叔的，在整个云海宗就那么几个人。
玉龙上人表情平静，似乎早就猜到此人会来似得。
“你长空师兄来了，风儿，去把他请进来，再泡壶茶水送过来。”
叶风出了师父房间，便看到一个身穿紫衣，头发梳的一丝不苟的俊朗青年走进了院门。
这个青年真是英俊，剑眉星目，鼻梁挺拔，面如刀削，五官轮廓十分立体。
没有地球上那些奶油小生的娘里娘气，给人一种坚韧刚毅的感觉。
叶风知道这个比吴彦祖还要帅的年轻人，应该便是掌门云逸师伯的大弟子，独孤长空。
上次云霜儿给他讲述云海宗内部情况时提到过此人。
“长空师兄！”
叶风快步走上前，抱拳施礼。
“叶师弟，好久不见啊，都长这么高啦！
比小时候可英俊多啦！”
独孤长空面露和煦微笑，给人一种如沐春风的感觉，就像是邻家的大哥哥一般。
叶风挠了挠头，谦虚道：“长空师兄过奖了，和师兄相比，我只是米粒之辉而已啊。”
二人寒暄两句，便到了玉龙上人的门前。
叶风道：“师父，长空师兄来了。”
“进来吧。”
独孤长空整理了一下已经很合体的衣衫，然后迈步走了进去。
叶风没进去，他走向厨房给二人沏茶。
来到厨房，瞧见了黄灵儿在收拾。
黄灵儿好奇的道：“大师兄，那位师兄是谁啊？”
“他是掌门师伯的大弟子独孤长空，先前兽灵院弟子送来的茶叶呢？师父让沏一壶好茶送过去。”
“正好炉子里的水刚烧开。”
很快便沏好了茶水，黄灵儿则端着茶水走进父亲的房间。
独孤长空微笑道：“这位便是灵儿师妹吧，果然根骨奇佳，是不可多得的修炼之才，看来我们云海宗又要多一位奇女子啦。”
玉龙上人呵呵笑道：“那是，也不看是谁的闺女！
不出二十年，灵儿必定是名动天下的绝世仙子啊。”
黄灵儿被老爹夸的有些尴尬。
说了一声“灵儿见过长空师兄”
，然后便退出了房间。
“这丫头什么都好，就是脸皮薄了点，也不知道给她师兄倒茶。”
玉龙上人嘀咕一声。
欲要亲自给独孤长空斟茶，
作为晚辈，独孤长空自然不能让长辈伺候，立刻拿起茶壶。
笑道：“灵儿师妹初来，还有些怕生，过些时日便好了。”
content_en:
There are only a few people in the entire Yunhai Sect who can be called Master Yulong's sixth uncle.
Master Jade Dragon's expression was calm, as if he had already guessed that this person would come.
"Your senior brother Changkong is here, Feng'er, go and invite him in, and make a pot of tea and bring it over."
Ye Feng left the master's room and saw a handsome young man wearing purple clothes and meticulously combed hair walking into the courtyard door.
This young man is really handsome, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, a straight nose, a face as sharp as a knife, and a very three-dimensional outline of his facial features.
It doesn't have the girlishness of those creamy boys on earth, giving people a feeling of toughness and resoluteness.
Ye Feng knew that this young man, who was even more handsome than Wu Yanzu, should be the eldest disciple of Master Yun Yi, Dugu Changkong.
Yun Shuang'er mentioned this person last time when she told him about the internal situation of Yun Haizong.
"Senior Brother Changkong!"
Ye Feng walked forward quickly, cupped his fists and saluted.
"Junior brother Ye, long time no see, you've grown so tall!
He is much more handsome than when he was a child! "
Dugu Changkong's warm smile gave people a feeling of spring breeze, like the big brother next door.
Ye Feng scratched his head and said humbly: "Senior Brother Changkong is a compliment. Compared with senior brother, I am just a grain of glory."
The two exchanged a few words before arriving at Master Jade Dragon's door.
Ye Feng said: "Master, Senior Brother Changkong is here."
"Come in."
Dugu Changkong adjusted his clothes that already fit him well, and then stepped inside.
Ye Feng didn't go in. He walked to the kitchen to make tea for the two of them.
When I came to the kitchen, I saw Huang Linger cleaning up.
Huang Ling'er asked curiously: "Senior Brother, who is that Senior Brother?"
"He is Dugu Changkong, the eldest disciple of the master uncle. Where is the tea sent by the disciples of the Beast Spirit Academy earlier? Master asked me to make a pot of good tea and send it over."
"The water in the stove just happened to be boiling."
The tea was quickly made, and Huang Ling'er walked into her father's room with the tea.
Dugu Changkong smiled and said, "This must be Junior Sister Ling'er. She really has excellent bones and is a rare talent for cultivation. It seems that our Yunhai Sect will have another strange woman."
Master Jade Dragon chuckled and said: "That is, it doesn't matter whose daughter it is!
In less than twenty years, Ling'er will definitely be a peerless fairy who will be famous all over the world. "
Huang Ling'er was a little embarrassed by her father's praise.
He said, "Ling'er has met Senior Brother Changkong."
, and then exited the room.
"This girl is good at everything, but she is a bit thin-skinned and doesn't know how to pour tea for her senior brother."
Master Jade Dragon muttered.
I want to pour tea for Dugu Changkong myself,
As a junior, Dugu Changkong naturally couldn't let his elders serve him, so he immediately picked up the teapot.
He smiled and said, "Junior sister Ling'er is still a little scared when she first comes here, but she will get better after some time."
